theorems.name: Submission.rsod_lipschitz_c1_approx_closedBall
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Rn n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ (R : ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < ε → ∃ g : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ volume (closedBall (0 : Rn n) R ∩ {x | f x ≠ g x}) < ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
